name: Core Furnace
blurb: Coaxes old warmth up from the planet's heart. Purrs when it's working.

name: Gas Sifter
blurb: Sieves buried ices into a young sky, one soft exhale at a time.

name: Vapor Well
blurb: Breathes gently on frozen ground until it remembers how to be rain.

name: Spore Garden
blurb: A warm, damp room where small green thoughts learn to stay. Life is slow, and will not be hurried.
